# Board report

## Decision

Approve the roof repair before winter.

## Background

The building opened in 1972. The roof is old. Water entered twice in May.

## Repetition

The roof is old. Repair is needed before winter.

## Budget

The quote is $12,400, contingency $1,600, total $14,000. The reserve is $18,000.

## Decorative history

The original opening ceremony featured a brass band and four speeches.
